name: Suehiro Madoka
source:
An office lady in the sales department.
A strange girl who seems strong yet weak, weak yet strong.
Although she makes fun of middle-aged men, she actually has a fetish for older men.
She is carefree no matter what, but when she falls in love with a man, she will risk her life to protect him.


[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040616154153/http://www.elf-game.co.jp/net_shop/soft/special/kisaku/kisaku4.html]the game's website, archived[/url]]
